newsitem.title: USA: French govt open to retirement funds-finmin.
newsitem.headline: French govt open to retirement funds-finmin.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominque Strauss-Kahn said on Saturday that France's new Socialist-led government was not opposed in principle to retirement savings funds but wanted a law introducing pension funds to France re-examined.
"We have no reason to refuse the idea of havings savings funds," he told reporters after a meeting of the Group of Seven rich nations.
But, he said, "the law as it stands should be re-examined."
France's previous centre-right government earlier this year introduced a law paving the way for the introduction of private pension funds to complement the existing system of universal savings.
The then opposition Socialists criticised the contents of the law, notably an exemption from social security charges of employer contributions to the funds.
French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said during his election campaign that the Socialists would repeal the law.
